name: Slack
description: Read your recent messages and joined conversations. Use conversations.history and bounded oldest timestamps; auth.test identifies the connected account.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: Discord
description: Read channels and recent messages accessible to your bot. Respect channel permissions and message content intent; do not post messages.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: Linear
description: Read assigned issues and updates through GraphQL. Discover the current viewer and bound issue updatedAt queries.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: Todoist
description: Read your tasks and completed activity with documented v1 endpoints. A current list of old tasks is undated context, not activity now.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: Asana
description: Read your assigned tasks and recent task stories. Begin with the current user and accessible workspaces; use bounded modified-since reads.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: ClickUp
description: Read your spaces, tasks and recent changes. Discover teams from /api/v2/team and use documented date_updated filters.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: Notion
description: Read pages shared with your integration. Use search with last_edited_time sorting and bounded page/block reads. Only shared pages are accessible. Send Notion-Version: 2025-09-03.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: Airtable
description: Read records in bases explicitly granted to this personal access token. Discover base schemas and read bounded records; use actual source timestamps when present.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: Raindrop.io
description: Read saved bookmarks with stable IDs, created and lastUpdate timestamps. Bound recent reads using the documented search API.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: Readwise
description: Read highlights updated since the connection history floor using updated__gt. Follow documented next links only on this origin.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: Readwise Reader
description: Read saved documents with updatedAfter and pageCursor. A document library is context; use actual saved/read timestamps when available.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: ListenBrainz
description: Read your recent music listens via /1/user/{user_name}/listens with bounded min_ts and max_ts. Discover your username with validate-token.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: Spotify
description: Read recently played tracks via /v1/me/player/recently-played using after milliseconds. Requires user-read-recently-played. A manually supplied access token expires; use the OAuth API for unattended refresh.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: Oura
description: Read recent sleep, activity and readiness summaries from /v2/usercollection with bounded start_date and end_date. Dates are daily context, not invented event instants. Supply an OAuth access token; legacy personal access tokens are no longer supported. Use the OAuth API for unattended refresh.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: Fitbit
description: Read activity summaries for your connected Fitbit account. Use documented daily date ranges; use the OAuth API for refreshable sign-in.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: Strava
description: Read your recent activities via /api/v3/athlete/activities with after and before unix seconds. Requires activity:read; use OAuth for refreshing access.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: Toggl Track
description: Read your recent time entries through /api/v9/me/time_entries using bounded start_date and end_date. Supply a Basic credential (base64 of api_token:api_token).
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: Clockify
description: Read workspaces and your recent time entries through /api/v1, with bounded start/end filters. Discover the current user first.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: GitLab
description: Read your user events, projects and merge requests with bounded after/before dates. Use read_api scope.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: Sentry
description: Read your accessible projects and recent issue events. Use bounded statsPeriod and environment filters; only source event time proves activity.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: Jira Cloud
description: Read recent issues and worklogs through REST v3. Supply a Basic credential (base64 of email:API token); use bounded JQL updated filters.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: Cal.com
description: Read your recent bookings and meeting activity. Use bounded time filters and the documented API version.
requirements: A read-only API token with access to the described personal data.

name: Gmail
description: Read Gmail through the installed, signed-in gws CLI. messages.list returns IDs only: use detail messages.get, internalDate unix_ms and Subject from payload.headers. Bound q with after:{{since_unix}}. Auth exit code 2. Do not change the login or use --page-all.
requirements: Install gws and sign in separately before connecting. This API never installs software or changes CLI login.

name: Google Calendar
description: Read Google Calendar through the installed, signed-in gws CLI. Bound events.list timeMin/timeMax, use nextPageToken and start.dateTime/end.dateTime. Skip date-only floating events in timed recipes. Auth exit code 2.
requirements: Install gws and sign in separately before connecting. This API never installs software or changes CLI login.

name: Google Drive
description: Read recent file changes through installed, signed-in gws. Use drive files list with modifiedTime filters and bounded pageSize. Shared files require read permissions.
requirements: Install gws and sign in separately before connecting. This API never installs software or changes CLI login.

name: Apple Bridge
description: Read personal Mac data via Apple Bridge MCP. Discover read tools such as calendar_agenda, reminders and health where available. Use bounded recent ranges. Never request Mac permissions or start services during setup.
requirements: An Apple Bridge MCP server already running on this Mac with its required permissions.
